integrity: General proof is self-contained; finite independently implemented checks are corroboration only. Literature priority is best-knowledge, not exhaustively established.
limitations: Exact results require three equal independent partite classes, strict-majority thresholds, synchronous non-progressive updating, and unit cost per agent-round; do not extend the formula to arbitrary graph or threshold assignments.
title: Exact timed majority-seeding cost on balanced tripartite social networks
